summary: A delegate can see the rest of the precinct near the front from the row where the ushers sent them.
realLife: Harrington described himself and Chapman alone in a back row in Hinds County while white members of their precinct sat near the front, despite the usual precinct seating.
gates: The seating assignment separates a delegate from their own precinct.
inGame: needs: precinct assignments and actual seating by row.

turns.what: The two can consult each other during votes.
turns.pulledBy: Another member brings a chair to the back.
turns.writesBack: The seating record still shows the original separation.

turns.what: An usher clears a place in its row.
turns.pulledBy: The chair grants the delegate’s request to sit with the precinct.
turns.writesBack: The corrected assignment appears on the seating chart.
